newsitem.title: USA: Texaco says '96 US upstream operations strong.
newsitem.headline: Texaco says '96 US upstream operations strong.

text.p: Texaco Inc said its U.S. upstream operations had record 1996 operating net of $1.1 billion, although added that the company's fourth-quarter refining and marketing results were disappointing.
According to the company's chairman, Peter Bijur, strong commodity prices throughout the year and higher worldwide oil and natural gas production caused the upstream earnings to rise sharply.

Bijur said the fourth-quarter refining and marketing results were adversely affected by product margins, especially on the West Coast, which were squeezed by higher crude costs and competitive pressures in the marketplace.
He also said two refinery incidents raised costs and impacted yields.
Officials from Texaco were not immediately available to comment further.
